description: Returns the text of one page of the site, or of one section by its anchor, with its exact URL. Use it before stating a detail that is not in an excerpt returned by another tool: a condition, a limit, a legal point, how a feature works. Give a URL returned by a tool; with its #anchor, only that section is returned, which is shorter. Reads only pages of this site: to find a page, use chercher.

ancre.description: Anchor of one section of the page (without #): returns that section only.

langue.description: Language of the buyer's question (en, fr, es): always pass it, the pages and answers are in this language.

url.description: URL or path of a page of this site, as returned by a tool. With a #anchor, only that section is returned.

name: lire_page
title: Read a page
